s.how: Trim 2 bunches of radishes, leaving a little green. Serve with 50g soft butter and a pinch bowl of sea salt for dipping. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

s.note: Peter and his sisters raiding the garden
s.how: Cut 3 carrots into sticks, trim 150g snow peas and separate a baby cos into cups. Serve with 200g Greek yoghurt mixed with lemon and salt.

m.how: Soften 2 sliced leeks and 3 diced carrots, add 200g peas. Make a cheese sauce with 300ml milk and 150g cheddar, stir in the veg, top with puff pastry and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

w.note: the blackberry attack on Thomas McGregor
w.how: Tip 750g blackberries into a dish with 2 tbsp sugar. Rub 100g butter into 120g flour and 100g brown sugar, scatter on top and bake at 180C for 35 minutes. Serve with cream.

d.how: Steep 4 chamomile tea bags in 1L boiling water for 5 minutes and sweeten with honey. Pour apple juice over ice for the kids. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
